tui.analytics.chart.daily_empty.note: The daily chart's empty state, dim, indented two cells at its use site. Shown when the store returned an empty (not None) series: 'no usage yet', not 'failed' — the two must not collapse.

tui.analytics.chart.metric_clause.note: Self-describes the active metric and the toggle key: 'cost · t → tokens'. Shared by both charts' section metas so they speak one voice. {active}/{other} arrive from the METRIC_* machine vocabulary (cost/tokens); translating the metric NAMES themselves is a follow-up if that vocabulary becomes user copy.

tui.analytics.chart.monthly_empty.note: Monthly chart's empty state; sibling of the daily one, same rules.

tui.analytics.chart.monthly_meta.note: Prefix that distinguishes the monthly chart's bucket from the daily one; joins the metric clause: 'by calendar month · cost · t → tokens'.

tui.analytics.chart.monthly_title.note: Section title for the monthly bars. Title-case like every section header.

tui.analytics.empty.hint.note: The one line telling a first-time user how the screen fills; legible on purpose (dim, not faint). Never truncated by design — the block crops rows, this hint is short enough to survive.

tui.analytics.empty.title.note: The empty ledger's first line, full-strength fg.

tui.analytics.header.metric.note: The pinned title's chart-metric suffix ('bars: cost'), shown only when a chart exists to toggle. Shown while scrolled so the advertised key never reads dead. {metric} is the METRIC_* word.

tui.analytics.header.scope.note: The pinned title's scope suffix ('all sessions'); faint, appended after the title with a three-space gap the code adds.

tui.analytics.header.title.note: The analytics screen's pinned title. One title voice across overlays (bold fg, not the violet label).

tui.analytics.hint.expand.compact.note: Hint-ladder tier: expandable rows, narrower box — drops 'esc back' but keeps both expand keys named.

tui.analytics.hint.expand.full.note: Hint-ladder tier: expandable rows, no chart toggle to advertise. Widest tier after the metric one.

tui.analytics.hint.expand.full_metric.note: Hint-ladder tier: expandable rows WITH charts (adds the metric toggle). The ladder picks the first tier that fits the real box; widths are per-locale concerns after a wave (RFC §7) — re-measure, do not trust this en length.

tui.analytics.hint.expand.keys.note: Hint-ladder tier: very narrow — expand abbreviated to the bare key, both keys still named (an abbreviation that drops the key name documents nothing).

tui.analytics.hint.expand.keys_bare.note: Hint-ladder floor: the two keys, nothing else. 'esc back' is never re-added below this tier.

tui.analytics.hint.none.full.note: Hint tier: no rows and nothing to scroll — only the way out remains.

tui.analytics.hint.none.full_metric.note: Hint tier: no rows, nothing to scroll, charts present — esc plus the metric toggle.

tui.analytics.hint.rows.bare.note: Hint tier: rows exist, narrow — the cursor keys alone.

tui.analytics.hint.rows.full.note: Hint tier: rows exist, no charts — esc plus the cursor keys.

tui.analytics.hint.rows.full_metric.note: Hint tier: rows exist, charts present, wide — esc, the metric toggle, the cursor keys. 'row' (not 'scroll') names the half a reader needs: the cursor moves on every ledger with rows.

tui.analytics.hint.scroll.bare.note: Hint tier: no cursorable rows but scrollable content — the arrows only scroll.

tui.analytics.hint.scroll.full.note: Hint tier: scrollable, no charts — esc plus the scroll keys.

tui.analytics.hint.scroll.full_metric.note: Hint tier: scrollable with charts, wide.

tui.analytics.input.empty.note: The input-attribution block's empty line ('no component data yet'), indented two cells and dim at its use site.

tui.analytics.input.meta.note: Section meta stating the split is ESTIMATED — the honesty label the section's data level also carries (the ≈ mark).

tui.analytics.input.title.note: Section header for the input attribution table (where the context tokens went).

tui.analytics.legend.cost.note: STILL A FROZEN ENGLISH CONSTANT at extraction time (``analytics_panel.COST_LEGEND``): imported by ``session_panel.py`` for the /session screen, so keying it here would change a surface this slice does not own. Deferred to the slice that takes both screens' legend (or the session-panel slice); the internal three-space run before '$—' is deliberate alignment and must survive any future edit.

tui.analytics.model.capped.note: Says the table is capped so a truncated list never reads as 'these are all your models'. {limit} is the read bound (MODEL_RATES_LIMIT), rendered as digits.

tui.analytics.model.empty.note: The ANSWERED-but-empty state: a claim about the ledger, distinct from pending (no answer yet) and failed (query broke). Parenthesised, dim, indented at its use site.

tui.analytics.model.failed.note: The read broke. 'the rest of this report is unaffected' is load-bearing: it tells the reader the failure is scoped, not the screen.

tui.analytics.model.legend.note: The two rate columns and what the dash means; drawn whenever ANY cell is unknown. 'wall = whole call' must not be shortened to a rate word — decode vs wall is the diagnosis this table exists for.

tui.analytics.model.meta.note: Scope note: the rows come from the raw ledger, all time — the same scope the headline covers, so a row can be held against the headline.

tui.analytics.model.pending.note: The read is in flight (it is a slow grouped scan): 'no rows' and 'no answer yet' are different facts.

tui.analytics.model.title.note: Section header for the per-model rate table.

tui.analytics.rate.legend.note: Coverage footnote under both tables: the decode rate speaks for {shown} of {total} calls. Drawn once, only when coverage is partial (a fully-measured run draws nothing). {shown}/{total} format with grouping; the noun is invariable — "calls" for every total at extraction, never pluralise it.

tui.analytics.search.by_provider.note: Dim sub-label partitioning the search block's total by provider; indented two cells at its use site. Same words as the model table's header — kept a second key for its distinct role (a partition note, not a table header).

tui.analytics.search.counted_read.note: A count of page reads ('3 reads'). Kept apart from searches: a row recorded under <provider>:read exists precisely to keep reads out of the search count.

tui.analytics.search.counted_search.note: A count of searches ('5 searches'); the plural of this word is not an s-suffix, which is why it is a catalogue plural rather than a suffix.

tui.analytics.search.incl_free_read.note: The cost note's free-volume half for a reads-only session; branch on COUNTERS, never on money (zero usd is also 'unpriced').

tui.analytics.search.incl_free_search.note: The cost note's free-volume half for searches; a zero money figure names nothing, the volume form survives the 80-column crop.

tui.analytics.search.incl_money_read.note: The cost note's money half (reads kind). {money} arrives pre-formatted by format_cost — including its honesty marks (+/$—) — never re-format it.

tui.analytics.search.incl_money_search.note: The cost note's money half (search kind). {money} pre-formatted by format_cost; the '$0.0000 search' defect this branch replaced is why zero never takes it.

tui.analytics.search.incl_unpriced_read.note: The cost note for unpriced reads; counted apart from unpriced searches (the split happens before the naming).

tui.analytics.search.incl_unpriced_searc.note: The cost note for unpriced searches; 'unpriced' is the ledger's counter, not an inference from money.

tui.analytics.search.meta_bars.note: Search section meta with the bars advertisement appended ('{meta} · bars: operations'). Only when a bar is actually drawn — below the threshold the clause orphaned a line and cropped mid-word.

tui.analytics.search.meta_live.note: The search block's meta on /analytics: the ledger it reads is the live process-wide one.

tui.analytics.search.note.note: The search block's note: why the numbers exist before disk and who is NOT counted. Wrapped with an indented continuation at its use site; keep the sentence structure if a translation reflows.

tui.analytics.search.note_join.note: Joins a search-count rung with the read half's own rung; both {note}/{read_note} are ALREADY-RENDERED strings from sibling keys.

tui.analytics.search.note_read_full.note: Read-count rung for an all-unpriced scope ('3 reads · no published price').

tui.analytics.search.note_read_partial.note: Read-count rung mixing priced and unpriced ('5 reads · 2 unpriced'); the unpriced tally is a parameter, the count still leads.

tui.analytics.search.note_read_unpriced.note: The short read rung ('5 reads · unpriced'); after it the qualifier wraps to its own indented line rather than being cropped away.

tui.analytics.search.note_search_full.note: Search-count rung for an all-unpriced scope; the count is on every rung because it is the part that must not be lost.

tui.analytics.search.note_search_partial.note: Search-count rung mixing priced and unpriced; the third number must reconcile with the row above it or a reader recomputes by hand.

tui.analytics.search.note_search_unprice.note: The short search rung; the ladder's tail when width is scarce.

tui.analytics.search.row_session.note: The current session's own row in the search block (space between total and session rows is premium; the row exists only when the share is worth showing).

tui.analytics.search.row_total.note: The search block's reference row: the process-wide total. No bar on it — it is what every other bar is measured against.

tui.analytics.search.share_bare.note: Narrowest share rung ('5 searches · 100% share'): keeps a referent — a bare '· 100%' says a proportion of nothing.

tui.analytics.search.share_short.note: Compact share rung ('· 100% of search'); shorter than 'of search spend' but still names what the share is OF. {counted} is an already-rendered sibling key.

tui.analytics.search.share_spend.note: Widest share rung for the session row; {counted} arrives rendered from the counted_* keys.

tui.analytics.search.summary_free.note: Free-only summary rung ('6 free'); no '· $0.0000' — structurally always zero there, which is why it is absent by design.

tui.analytics.search.summary_free_paid.note: Both-halves summary ('3 of 5 priced free · $0.0000 paid'): the denominator is the PRICED operations, which is what makes the numbers reconcile. {free}/{priced} are plain digits; {money} is format_cost output.

tui.analytics.search.summary_paid_short.note: Compact paid-only rung ('2 paid') — the money sheds first, the count never.

tui.analytics.search.title.note: The search-spend block's section header. Shared by /analytics and /session — one vocabulary, two screens.

tui.analytics.search.unpriced_clause.note: The appended unpriced tally (' · 2 unpriced') on summary ladders; the code adds the leading space. Dropped entirely when there is nothing unpriced.

tui.analytics.table.by_provider.note: The model-usage provider table's section header (distinct from the search block's dim sub-label of the same words — this one is a full section).

tui.analytics.table.by_session.note: The per-session table's section header; its meta may say 'totals include subagents'.

tui.analytics.table.cache.note: The cache-percentage tail ('42% cache'). {value} is pre-padded by the caller (the column pad lives in code); the WORD lives here for measurement: _row_overhead reads this tail's cell width to budget the row.

tui.analytics.table.calls.note: The calls-count tail ('317,977 calls'). {value} pre-padded to the column by the caller; the word is measured (cell_len of this rendered tail) by _row_overhead — never hard-code its width.

tui.analytics.table.coverage.note: The per-model coverage tail ('8/10 calls') — calls covered out of calls made; plain digits, no grouping in either number (they are both small; the original form predates grouping).

tui.analytics.table.empty.note: The '(none)' line both empty tables draw (session and group sections); parenthesised, dim, indented at its use site.

tui.analytics.table.subagent_suffix.note: The '+12 subagents' tail a root row advertises after its name (the hidden-row count). Shown in BOTH expand states: a suffix that disappeared on expand would change the widest label and reflow every numeric column on a keypress. Spelled with the word (not a bare '+12') because every other number on the row is money/tokens/calls.

tui.analytics.table.tok_s.note: The rate tail ('41.2 tok/s'; '— tok/s' when unmeasured). {value} pre-padded by the caller; the word is width-measured by _row_overhead/_model_rate_section's reserve.

tui.analytics.table.tokens.note: The tokens tail ('3.7M tokens'). {value} arrives pre-formatted (format_tokens) and pre-padded to the column; the word is cell_len-measured for the row budget.

tui.analytics.totals.billed_note.note: The billed row's composition note ('3.5M in · 120k out'); {context}/{output} pre-formatted by format_tokens.

tui.analytics.totals.cache_hit_note.note: What the cache-hit figure is OF ('of context served from cache'); plain lowercase clause that follows the value.

tui.analytics.totals.cache_read.note: Tree-row label under Context read. The code adds the ' \u251c ' glyph+spaces; the message is the words only.

tui.analytics.totals.cache_read_note.note: One-line explanation for the cache-read tree row.

tui.analytics.totals.cache_write.note: Tree-row label (last child: the code adds the ' \u2514 ' glyph).

tui.analytics.totals.cache_write_note.note: One-line explanation for the cache-write tree row.

tui.analytics.totals.calls_failed.note: The failed-call clause appended to the Totals meta ('(2 failed)') — real information, not chrome; shown only when ok_calls != calls. Plain digits (the original form predates grouping).

tui.analytics.totals.calls_meta.note: The Totals meta's call count ('426 calls'); the failed clause and '· measured' are appended by code with single spaces.

tui.analytics.totals.calls_measured.note: The '· measured' suffix on the Totals meta — the denominator honesty for every rate that follows.

tui.analytics.totals.context_note.note: The Context-read note restating the tree's composition ('3M fresh · 3.4M cached · 78k written') so compact formatting cannot hide the sum. All three pre-formatted.

tui.analytics.totals.context_read.note: Row label: the full context read (the parent of the three cache tree rows). Authoritative provider counts, not estimates.

tui.analytics.totals.days_empty.note: The daily chart's static title when the series is empty (no count to state); the counted form below is the non-empty sibling.

tui.analytics.totals.days_with_usage.note: The daily chart's counted title ('3 days with usage'). 'with usage' is exact: the series skips idle days, so it is not a calendar span. Singular for one.

tui.analytics.totals.decode.note: Row label: decode rate (how fast the models actually generate).

tui.analytics.totals.decode_note.note: What the decode figure measures; the coverage footnote below the tables says how much of the ledger it speaks for.

tui.analytics.totals.fresh.note: Tree-row label: ALL uncached input (new turns plus fresh tool results/system content), NOT 'user input' — labelling it as user messages would be wrong. Glyph added by code.

tui.analytics.totals.fresh_note.note: One-line explanation for the fresh tree row ('new input, billed at full rate').

tui.analytics.totals.output_note.note: The output row's generation/thinking split ('12k generation, 4k thinking'); both pre-formatted.

tui.analytics.totals.subagent_meta.note: The session table's meta when the forest has children: explains why a root's figure exceeds its own spend and that indented rows are already counted in the row above.
